title: Strata bundle policies, version 1
description: Second input of the bundle compiler: policies with their signed mode, and the default block page shipped in the bundle.

canary_percent.description: Enforce canary (nginx-module.md › Bật enforce theo canary): share of clients, by a stable hash of (identity or client address, policy name), whose requests this enforce policy blocks; the other clients run in shadow. 0.01 to 99.99, two decimals; leave out for 100%. Only with mode enforce. Needs libstrata with W11-R-01 on every node: older ones refuse the bundle.

signatures.description: Rules of the signature pack (RV-S-01: metadata.source sigma, et-open, crawler-user-agents): shadow (default) runs and reports them but never lets them block, even in enforce; off skips them; enforce lets them block like the core pack (CRS, protocol, virtual patches, organization rules). Needs libstrata with RV-S-01 on every node for off and enforce.

oversize.description: Request bodies larger than the connector inspects (strata_request_body_limit): pass (default) or block. The API template should use block.

staged_rules.description: Compiler-internal signed log-only overlay, 0..16 distinct managed request Rule IDs. The public policy API accepts only auto_staging delegation, not effective staged_rules. Requires staging-aware engines (mandatory policy bit); no automatic expiry or re-enforcement.

exceptions.description: Exact expiring field exclusions for managed rules. Requires exception-aware engines on every node; older engines refuse the mandatory policy flag. Changes go through policy draft/replay/four-eyes/deploy, including revocation.

privacy.description: Privacy settings (P-01 §1), on top of the built-in ones (sensitive names, CCCD, JWT, card numbers, always on): field names whose input is never kept in events (case-insensitive: a parameter, a header, the last part of a JSON path), and patterns masked with '*' in event snippets and headers (regex crate syntax, linear time, must not match the empty string). Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle with it.

identity.description: plain (default): events carry the identity as it is; hmac: events carry hmac: and the hex of the first 16 bytes of HMAC-SHA256 with the installation's identity key, so the same client keeps the same value without the value leaving the node. Another key gives other values.

max_args.description: Arguments the policy inspects: query fields, then body fields (form, JSON leaves, multipart fields), 1 to 1020, rounded up to a multiple of 4; 1024 when absent (#28). A request with more goes by `oversize` (rule 100021): blocked, or passed with only these inspected (event inspection PARTIAL). Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle that sets it: upgrade the module on every node first.

fail_on_findings.description: #98: when the CPU budget runs out on a request that already has findings (rules matched below the blocking threshold), `block` answers as in fail mode closed (503 with the Event ID) whatever the connector's fail mode; `pass` (default) follows the fail mode. Enforce only: a shadow policy never blocks. Measure the share of such requests in shadow first (`strata-rules lifecycle`). Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle that sets block: upgrade the module on every node first.

parse_error.description: Audit 22/10/2026: a request body the engine cannot read to its end (rule 100022: JSON damaged or nested deeper than 64, XML or multipart damaged) or at all (100023: Content-Encoding other than identity). The client chooses to send one, and the backend may still read it: `block` (default) blocks alone in enforce, whatever `oversize` says; `pass` only records it (inspection PARTIAL), as before the audit. Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle that sets pass: upgrade the module on every node first.

crs_paranoia.description: W17-S-01: CRS paranoia level enforced (1 by default): CRS rules up to it score and block as usual. Rules carry their level; rules without one (not CRS) always run. Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle that sets a level other than 1: upgrade the module on every node first.

crs_paranoia_shadow.description: W17-S-01: CRS paranoia level run in shadow, at least crs_paranoia (its value by default): CRS rules above crs_paranoia up to it run and are reported (Event ID EVT-, false positive table), but their score is kept apart and they never block, like the signature pack in shadow. Try a higher level this way before raising crs_paranoia. Rules above every policy's level are left out of the bundle.

geo_rules.description: W19-G2-01: the policy's own rules on the country and ASN of the client address (W19-R-01), each run for this policy only. A rule matches an address in one of its countries or ASNs; with not, an address outside all of them (local addresses excepted). block: the request is blocked on the rule alone; log: it is reported with an Event ID and never blocks. ids are 190000-199999, unique across all policies (the control plane assigns them). Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle with them: upgrade the module on every node first.

crs_plugins.description: W17-S-01: CRS plugins (rule exclusions for an application: wordpress, drupal, nextcloud, phpmyadmin, phpbb, xenforo, dokuwiki, cpanel) the policy runs: on that application's known paths and fields, they take listed CRS rules or targets away so its normal traffic does not match. Each name must have rules in the bundle's rule set. Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle with them: upgrade the module on every node first.

max_snippet_size.description: Longest input snippet of a match in the policy's events, in bytes, masked before it is cut (P-01 §1b): 128 by default; 2048 or 4096 to investigate. Engines from before the setting refuse a bundle with 2048 or 4096: upgrade the module on every node first.

response.description: Response layer, all off by default. Findings are recorded (rules 600000-699999), never block: the response headers are already on their way. Data guard masks only in enforce mode; in shadow it only records.

allowed_codes_check.description: Status outside the allowed codes: rule 600001.

db_errors.description: Database error messages in the body: rules 600101-600107.

data_guard.description: Values masked with '*' (same length) in the body: cccd (Vietnamese citizen ID, rule 600201), jwt (JSON Web Token, rule 600202), pan (payment card number, 13-19 digits with a valid Luhn check, rule 600203). Do not enable jwt on routes that issue tokens.

block_page.description: Default HTML block page: placeholders {{block_id}}, {{time}}, {{support_contact}}. html_file is relative to this file.
